title: Army money continues after the Round Table closes

tellings.quote: But, it all the while he was getting money from the Army. I mean, there's records of that.

plain: A group called the Round Table, which met in Maine and is said to have tried to contact an alien council, wound up around 1957, but the man at its center kept getting money from the US Army the whole time. The researcher Greg Malatzi says this and points to Army funding records, saying "there's records of that." If true, it would mean the military was quietly paying for the work.
